decisions.reason: The IMU module is a core, low-cost building block of the modular platform with steady developer and education demand.
The industrial AC voltage input module supports the firm's industrial automation and energy-management direction and has its own product page.
A four-channel solid state relay is a standard control component that complements the platform at minimal maintenance cost.
The server room kit bundles existing modules cheaply, but it faces some risk of rationalisation as the platform migrates to newer connectors.
The recently launched RGB LED module extends the building block system and is cheap to keep in stock.
The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion into charging and energy management and creates recurring customer value.
